cases.evidence: Frozen bootstrap expected the verifier-owned build_output directory and failed at mv before installation. Round 10 intentionally removed the runner hardcode; the next round must declare this external precondition as generic preregistered input.
Two files.pythonhosted.org ReadTimeout failures prevented installation of cmake for rapidfuzz build-system requirements.

conclusions: Every revised V3 probe that executed passed; there is no observed semantic regression from replacing CLI --help with console PATH resolution.
The fail-closed distribution aggregation path observed no collection error in the three completed cases.
Inflect does not justify a method change: its failure occurred before bootstrap semantics because an external workspace precondition was omitted from the Round 10 runner contract.
Poetry does not justify a method change: its failure is a repeated network read timeout and requires the preregistered infrastructure-only retry gate.
